newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's trade balance slumps by 7.4 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's trade balance slumps by 7.4 pct in May.

text.p: Morocco's trade balance slumped by 7.4 percent to 10.764 billion dirhams ($1.13 billion) in May 1997 from 11.624 billion the same month last year, the finance ministry said on Wednesday.

It said in its monthly report, expatriates remittances which represent a major contributor to the economy dropped 4.6 percent to 6.497 billion dirhams in May this year from 6.811 billion dirhams the same period last year.
Tourism, another important foreign currency earner, fell 5.4 percent to 4.175 billion dirhams in May this year from 4.415 billion dirhams the same period last year.
Exports, dominated by citrus, fish products and phosphates, had increased 11.0 percent to 25.511 billion dirhams in May this year from 22.988 billion dirhams in May 1996.

Imports, headed by crude oil, wheat and sugar, and industrial equipment and semi-finished products, rose 4.8 percent to 36.276 billion dirhams in the same period this year from 34.612 billion dirhams in May last year.
